title: Preliminary geologic map of the Barnwell 30' x 60' quadrangle, South Carolina and Georgia
citation: Prowell, D.C., 1994, Preliminary geologic map of the Barnwell 30' x 60' quadrangle, South Carolina and Georgia: U.S. Geological Survey Open-File Report OF-94-673, map scale 1:100,000.
notes: USGS OF-94-673 (Prowell, 1994), preliminary geologic map of the Barnwell 30'x60' quadrangle, SC and GA, 1:100,000 (text only; map plate not in this packet). Units in South Carolina recorded; the Belair belt metavolcanics are exposed only at Augusta, Georgia and are left out, as are Georgia core samples (VG-1, Vogtle 246, BMPD-1) and Griffins Landing. Core sample elevations (m and ft, datum not stated) kept in interval descriptions; the unit of each interval is from the paragraph and flagged inferred. Reference localities, Clinchfield thickness at Hancock Landing and the stratigraphic chart (page 21) not itemized. SUBSURFACE: core-sample elevations only.
